subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min demo for AuroraHealth
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0400
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min demo for AuroraHealth

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can get a demo on the calendar: 

Summary (from today's call):
- Primary use case: reduce inference cost and latency for patient-facing triage bot; integrate with on-prem EHR for embeddings.
- Traffic profile: ~2000 requests/day peak, mostly short sequences (~64 tokens).
- Success criteria: <150ms p95 latency, 3-4x cost reduction vs current hosted routes, and predictable SLA for production.

Proposed next step: 30-min product demo + technical Q&A with your platform/infra lead and our solutions engineer to cover integration patterns and performance expectations. 

I have three options (all ET):
1) Tue, Jun 23 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET
2) Wed, Jun 24 — 2:00–2:30 PM ET
3) Thu, Jun 25 — 10:00–10:30 AM ET

Can you confirm which slot works, and who from your side will join (platform/infra + product)? I attached a quick discovery notes PDF so you can circulate internally.

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m: intros and goals
- 15m: product demo (routing, caching, latency profiles)
- 7m: integration Qs (EHR, auth, VPC)
- 3m: next steps / decision criteria

If none of these slots work, tell me a couple times that do and I will coordinate. I’ll loop in our solutions engineer Aditya on the invite so he can cover the technical deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachment: AuroraHealth-Discovery-Notes.pdf

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@aurorahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Carla Mendes <carla.mendes@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min demo for AuroraHealth

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear recap. Wed, Jun 24 at 2:00 PM ET works best for us. I will join, and I'll invite our Head of Platform, Carla Mendes, and our engineering manager Mike Chen so they can see the integration flow.

Attendees from AuroraHealth: Jordan Lee (Product), Carla Mendes (Head of Platform), Mike Chen (Eng Manager)

Could you include any recommended pre-demo materials or items we should prepare? Also please send a calendar invitation.

Best,
Jordan

jordan.lee@aurorahealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0133

Perfect — Wed, Jun 24 at 2:00 PM ET is confirmed. I just created the calendar invite (link below) and attached a two-page Demo Checklist to help your team prepare.

Calendar invite: https://redwood.cloud/calendars/invite?event=RDW-2026-AUR-13
Attachment: Demo-Checklist.pdf

Attendees (AuroraHealth): Jordan Lee, Carla Mendes, Mike Chen

Aditya — looping you in here to cover the technical deep dive and any EHR integration concerns. If you want to cover anything specific (auth, throughput tests), let me know and I’ll add it to the agenda.

Agenda reminder: 5m intros / goals, 15m demo, 7m integration Qs, 3m next steps.

See you all Wed.

Best,
Vanessa

Thanks for the tag, Vanessa. I’ll be on the demo Wed and will prepare a short slide on EHR connector patterns and our VPC/KMS options given your compliance needs. Jordan/Carla — if you have a sample schema or an example endpoint we should mock, please send it ahead of the meeting; otherwise I’ll demo a typical on-prem connector and tokenized payload flow.

Looking forward to the conversation.
